svg.aria-label: Gyropup: A research robot designed to balance on two wheel-legs, with a foam-ball turret: CAD and simulation in the open.
svg.title: Gyropup: A research robot designed to balance on two wheel-legs, with a foam-ball turret: CAD and simulation in the open.
svg.desc: What is designed now, set as in docs/hero.jpg: the bench stand is traced, the foam-ball turret drops onto it on its compute plinth, leg v2 (the five-bar on two RS-04s, two links meeting at the wheel) slides in beside it, then the turret head scans left and right about its pan axis, nods about its tilt axis and holds a lock-on. Built by the project's own CadQuery code (cad/build_leg.py, cad/turret.py, cad/turret_stand.py) with hidden lines removed. Drawn from Valpatel/gyropup at commit 5e2483396dae.
